acceptanceEvidence: User explicitly said 这个单眨眼是不错的. Static appearance accepted; timing below is a proposal.

observedGeometry.openEye: Viewer-left / near eye remains the large softly tilted filled capsule.
observedGeometry.closedEye: Viewer-right / far eye becomes a single rounded inverted-U arch: apex up, ends down (∩). No point, chevron, diagonal slash or lower U shape.
observedGeometry.closedEyeStyle: Filled white continuous curved ribbon, rounded ends, subtle taper. No extra facial marks.
observedGeometry.ratioNote: Visual estimates from the source panel, not exact traced measurements; keep sphere perspective and the current neutral eye registration.

implementationConstraints: Preserve the open near capsule without simultaneous double blink.
Morph one eye path where feasible; never overlap open and closed versions visibly.
Project both eyes from one persistent sphere-facing coordinate system. Do not force a right-up view or snap to a reference pose.
Recovery restores neutral geometry at the latest sphere orientation.
No additional hands, mouth, eyebrow, decorative marks, bounce or new behavior mode is required.
